Carla R.: Quick follow-up on postmortem PM-2026-083 — looks like a few remediation items are still OPEN ahead of tomorrow's L3 rollup. Can owners confirm status?

Carla R.: Actions from the doc:
```
A1 - increase request-queue memory (owner: Ben T.) - due 2026-03-18
A2 - add rollback/fallback policy for model variant routing (owner: Dinesh P.) - due 2026-03-16
A3 - alert on prefix-cache eviction rate (owner: Alice M.) - due 2026-03-14
```

Ben T.: A1 in progress. PR open: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/runtime/pull/987 — waiting on Dinesh for perf test approval. ETA EOD Fri :clock4:.

Dinesh P.: I'll review the PR today, should be a quick perf check. had a flaky perf test yesterday, so might rerun once.

Alice M.: A3 done and deployed to staging. Monitoring looks stable, can promote after canary. Moving to "verifying" in the doc. :white_check_mark:

SRE Bot: :mega: Reminder: A2 is past its due date by 2 days.

Carla R.: Thanks all. Ben — can you link the PR to the postmortem doc and add a short testing note so I can mark A1 as "in-review" for tomorrow?

Ben T.: Done — added PR + test notes to the postmortem (see bottom of PM-2026-083). Also added a short rollback plan to the PR description. @Sandra L. can you QA smoke tomorrow morning?

Sandra L.: Yup, I'll run smoke tomorrow AM and report back here. quick local pass looked fine.

Carla R.: Perfect. Summary for L3: A3 -> done (Alice), A1 -> in-review (Ben) pending Dinesh perf signoff and Sandra QA, A2 -> overdue (Dinesh) please update ETA by EOD today or I'll escalate to Eng leads.

Dinesh P.: Ack — will post updated ETA by 18:00 UTC today. Sorry for the delay, chasing an infra flake that blocked rollout yesterday.

Carla R.: Thanks — appreciate it. If anything blocks Dinesh please @me and I'll coordinate escalation. :thumbsup:
